# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release of PTD GTFS Schedules. Please update to it before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

Report it privately instead on GitHub: [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/publictransitdata/WP-GTFS-schedules/security/advisories/new)

Tell us what an attacker can do, the steps to reproduce it, and the plugin and WordPress versions. We will reply and will keep you informed while we fix it, and credit you in the release notes unless you prefer otherwise.
